differences: The adapter derives the WMS token from the public page mfsession cookie at runtime when response headers are available; the cookie/token are not persisted.
The ephemeral WMS session token is appended only at the transport boundary; it is absent from FrameRef URI, locator, logical identity, and safe reporting projections.
The current WMS requires an explicit time dimension; the old request without time returned InvalidDimensionValue during the 2026-09-18 migration check.
WMS raw output has a stable timestamped PNG filename so HTTP 200 XML ServiceException responses fail the image-integrity check before an output can be committed.

The exact 700x600 EPSG:3857 WMS portrayal request bounds and a pixel-center control point are retained in FrameRef metadata and checked independently against pyproj; they cannot establish the native geometry of the radar measurements.

The old post-process encoding is reversible as dBZ (`gray / 16 * 5`) only when the artifact is explicitly identified as output after legacy reflectivity recovery. The current WMS RGBA artifact is not such a verified gray artifact, so scientific decode still fails until provider color mapping and native geometry are verified.

live_capabilities_audit.authentication: derived at runtime from the official radar page; token not persisted

get_legend_graphic_probe.result: upstream request-rejection page; no legend image or color values returned

live_capabilities_audit.conclusion: The advertised rendered layer exposes no queryable pixel values or legend/color-ramp reference; scientific color-to-dBZ decoding remains blocked.

official_scientific_api_audit.reflectivity_codes: official FAQ defines codes 0-79 as reflectivity intervals and 255 as missing; code 0 is near the noise floor
official_scientific_api_audit.migration_assessment: This is a viable provider-native scientific product path, but it does not prove the legacy WMS PNG palette or its requested EPSG:3857 portrayal grid. Adopting it requires an authorized API token, BUFR decoding/tables and a separate source-contract decision.

retained_frame_validation.reference_rgba_samples: all manifest samples match the retained raw PNG
retained_frame_validation.decode: fails closed for the current raw RGBA WMS artifact; the versioned legacy gray decoder is available only for explicitly identified post-process grayscale artifacts
retained_frame_validation.scope: T063 migration complete for verified WMS acquisition and scientific correction; native reflectivity mapping and radar-native geometry remain blocked under T065

blockers: A verified BASE_REFLECTIVITY color-to-dBZ mapping is still required before the legacy WMS PNG can become a scientific RadarField.
The official BUFR API is a candidate provider-native alternative, but no authorized token or retained BUFR sample is available for contract validation.
